name: poppler
input_api: poppler::document::load_from_file(const std::string&) on a local PDF path; pages()
family_note: Native Poppler C++ frontend over Poppler core; its other frontends share the same parser engine.

name: podofo
family_note: Native C++17 PoDoFo PDF document reader; distinct from Poppler.

name: qpdf
family_note: Native qpdf C++ parser; distinct from Poppler and PoDoFo.

name: mupdf
input_api: fz_open_document(fz_context*, const char* local filename); fz_count_pages(...) called from C++17
family_note: Direct MuPDF C API call from a C++17 translation unit; distinct from Poppler, PoDoFo, and qpdf. The official GitHub repository is a mirror of the canonical Ghostscript Git repository.
language_bridge: Pinned C API compiled and called from C++17 translation unit

name: ghostscript
input_api: gsapi_run_string on a local file path using Ghostscript PDF interpreter .PDFInit, .PDFFile, .PDFInfo /NumPages; C API called from C++17
family_note: Direct Ghostscript C API call from C++17; PDF interpreter is a distinct engine from Poppler, PoDoFo, qpdf, and MuPDF. Source archive is GhostPDL, which contains Ghostscript. Canonical upstream is Ghostscript Git; GitHub mirrors are not used for popularity.
language_bridge: Pinned C API compiled and called from C++17 translation unit

name: pdfio
input_api: pdfioFileOpen(const char* local filename, ...); pdfioFileGetNumPages and pdfioFileGetPage, called from C++17
scope: PDF document page count and first page object
family_note: Direct PDFio C API call from C++17; independent PDFio engine, built from its pinned source archive.
language_bridge: Pinned C API compiled and called from C++17 translation unit

name: pdfium
input_api: FPDF_LoadDocument(const char* local filename, nullptr); FPDF_GetPageCount and FPDF_LoadPage, called from C++17
scope: PDF document page count and first page object
family_note: Direct PDFium C API call from C++17. Prebuilt macOS arm64 artifact from bblanchon/pdfium-binaries chromium/8152 release is SHA-256 pinned; its original API header matches an independently pinned canonical PDFium source revision. Distribution is third-party; core engine is canonical PDFium. Binary provenance is limited to the distributor release claim and original header match.
language_bridge: Pinned C API compiled and called from C++17 translation unit

name: pdfwriter
family_note: Native C++ PDFParser in the PDF-Writer package; source-built from pinned v4.6.2 release with bundled Aesgm and system Zlib/FreeType. DCT, TIFF, and PNG integrations are disabled for this simple PDF control.

name: pdf4qt
family_note: Native PDF4QT C++ document reader built from pinned v1.6.0.0 source. Its pinned Blend2D dependency uses NO_JIT. A recorded patch enables core-only building with Qt 6.12 on macOS and replaces parallel-policy calls with sequential algorithms for Apple libc++; the adapter uses C++20.

name: qtpdf
input_api: QPdfDocument::load(const QString& local filename); error(); pageCount()
family_note: Qt PDF module from the separate QtWebEngine distribution exposes the QPdfDocument C++17 API and bundles PDFium internally. It shares the PDFium engine with the direct PDFium path but is a distinct third-party package/API. The installed 6.11.2_1 framework and official v6.11.2 header are hash checked; Qt6Pdf.pc reports 6.12.0 despite the Homebrew formula version, so both values are recorded.

name: xpdf
input_api: PDFDoc(char* local UTF-8 filename) after GlobalParams initialization; isOk(); getNumPages(), defined in xpdf/PDFDoc.h and used by xpdf/pdfinfo.cc in the pinned source archive
family_note: Xpdf 4.06 source publishes a CMake xpdf_objs object library containing PDFDoc; the verifier archives it and links its goo and fofi libraries for a direct C++17 adapter. There is no installed public libxpdf artifact or stable ABI claim. Poppler descends from older Xpdf code, but this is the independently maintained Xpdf 4.06 parser family.

name: pdfmm
family_note: Pdfmm 0.10.0 is a distinct C++17 library forked from PoDoFo and later moved back to the PoDoFo community. Its parser lineage is shared with PoDoFo, and its separate pinned source release is built as a shared library with direct dependency hashes recorded.
